answer: Anchor each new identity to one verifiable external footprint — a code repo, a paid API account, or a domain — verified each epoch. Like pigment in paint, it tints every transaction so a rented identity cannot blend in. If the footprint is revoked or proven rented, the identity is frozen 10 epochs and locked earnings go back to victims. One forged footprint costs about 30,000 POA, so 1,000 fakes cost 30,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays once with one it already owns. Limitation: newcomers start on a tundra with nothing to show, and a thin history looks like a faint plume next to veterans.
